newsitem.title: USA: CTG files for weather adjustment in bills.
newsitem.headline: CTG files for weather adjustment in bills.

text.p: CTG Resources Inc said Monday it asked regulators to include a weather normalization adjustment in its customer bills.
The holding company of the Connecticut Natural Gas Corp said it will include the adjustment in its bills issued between October and May this year if the Department of Public Utility Control approves.

The method adjusts bills to reflect normal instead of actual weather conditions, the company said. The method levels customer bills in months when colder-than-normal weather increases usage and allows the company to recoup fixed costs in warmer-than-normal months, CTG added.
CTG said utilities use the method in 13 states, including Connecticut.
